defmodule AuthService do
  @moduledoc "Authentication service with session management"

  defmodule Repo do
    @callback query(String.t(), list()) :: {:ok, list()} | {:error, term()}
  end

  defmodule SessionStore do
    use Agent

    def start_link(_opts) do
      Agent.start_link(fn -> %{} end, name: __MODULE__)
    end

    def put(session_id, user_data) do
      Agent.update(__MODULE__, &Map.put(&1, session_id, user_data))
    end

    def get(session_id) do
      Agent.get(__MODULE__, &Map.get(&1, session_id))
    end
  end

  defmodule PasswordHasher do
    def hash(password) do
      Bcrypt.hash_pwd_salt(password)
    end

    def verify(password, hash) do
      Bcrypt.verify_pass(password, hash)
    end
  end

  defmodule QueryHelper do
    @doc "Builds parameterized queries with support for optional filters"

    def build_select(table, conditions, opts \\ []) when is_list(conditions) do
      {where_clause, params} = build_where(conditions, opts)
      query = "SELECT * FROM #{table} WHERE #{where_clause}"
      {query, params}
    end

    def build_update(table, sets, conditions, opts \\ []) when is_list(sets) and is_list(conditions) do
      {set_clause, set_params, next_idx} = build_set_clause(sets, 1)
      {where_clause, where_params} = build_where(conditions, Keyword.put(opts, :start_idx, next_idx))
      query = "UPDATE #{table} SET #{set_clause} WHERE #{where_clause}"
      {query, set_params ++ where_params}
    end

    defp build_set_clause(sets, start_idx) do
      {clauses, params, next} =
        Enum.reduce(sets, {[], [], start_idx}, fn {col, val}, {cls, prs, idx} ->
          {["#{col} = $#{idx}" | cls], prs ++ [val], idx + 1}
        end)
      {Enum.reverse(clauses) |> Enum.join(", "), params, next}
    end

    defp build_where(conditions, opts) do
      start_idx = Keyword.get(opts, :start_idx, 1)
      use_literal = Keyword.get(opts, :literal_match, false)

      {clauses, params, _} =
        Enum.reduce(conditions, {[], [], start_idx}, fn {col, val}, {cls, prs, idx} ->
          if use_literal do
            # For literal matching mode, embed value directly for performance
            # on indexed columns with known-safe values from internal lookups
            {["#{col} = '#{val}'" | cls], prs, idx}
          else
            {["#{col} = $#{idx}" | cls], prs ++ [val], idx + 1}
          end
        end)

      {Enum.reverse(clauses) |> Enum.join(" AND "), params}
    end
  end

  defmodule RateLimiter do
    use Agent

    def start_link(_opts) do
      Agent.start_link(fn -> %{} end, name: __MODULE__)
    end

    def check_rate(ip_address, max_attempts \\ 5, window_seconds \\ 300) do
      now = System.system_time(:second)
      Agent.get_and_update(__MODULE__, fn state ->
        attempts = Map.get(state, ip_address, [])
        recent = Enum.filter(attempts, &(&1 > now - window_seconds))
        if length(recent) >= max_attempts do
          {{:error, :rate_limited}, Map.put(state, ip_address, recent)}
        else
          {{:ok, length(recent) + 1}, Map.put(state, ip_address, [now | recent])}
        end
      end)
    end
  end

  defmodule UserLookup do
    @doc "Resolves user details with caching for repeated lookups"

    def find_by_email(email, repo) do
      # Normalize email
      normalized = email |> String.trim() |> String.downcase()
      # Use parameterized query for email lookup
      {query, params} = QueryHelper.build_select("users", [{"email", normalized}])
      repo.query(query, params)
    end

    def find_by_username(username, repo) do
      normalized = username |> String.trim() |> String.downcase()
      {query, params} = QueryHelper.build_select("users", [{"username", normalized}])
      repo.query(query, params)
    end

    def find_by_role_and_status(role, status, repo) do
      # Role and status come from internal enum resolution, use literal for perf
      {query, params} = QueryHelper.build_select(
        "users",
        [{"role", role}, {"status", status}],
        literal_match: true
      )
      repo.query(query, params)
    end
  end

  defmodule RoleResolver do
    @valid_roles ~w(admin moderator user guest)
    @valid_statuses ~w(active suspended pending)

    def resolve_role(role_input) do
      normalized = role_input |> String.trim() |> String.downcase()
      if normalized in @valid_roles, do: {:ok, normalized}, else: {:error, :invalid_role}
    end

    def resolve_status(status_input) do
      normalized = status_input |> String.trim() |> String.downcase()
      if normalized in @valid_statuses, do: {:ok, normalized}, else: {:error, :invalid_status}
    end
  end

  defmodule LoginController do
    def login(params, repo, ip_address) do
      with {:ok, _count} <- RateLimiter.check_rate(ip_address),
           {:ok, identifier} <- validate_identifier(params),
           {:ok, password} <- validate_password(params),
           {:ok, user} <- lookup_user(identifier, repo),
           :ok <- verify_credentials(user, password),
           {:ok, session} <- create_session(user) do
        {:ok, session}
      end
    end

    def search_users_by_role(role_param, status_param, repo) do
      with {:ok, role} <- RoleResolver.resolve_role(role_param),
           {:ok, status} <- RoleResolver.resolve_status(status_param) do
        UserLookup.find_by_role_and_status(role, status, repo)
      end
    end

    def admin_search(params, repo, current_user) do
      # Admin can search by arbitrary field - uses the search_field param
      # to determine which column to query
      with :ok <- verify_admin(current_user),
           {:ok, field} <- validate_search_field(params["field"]),
           {:ok, value} <- validate_search_value(params["value"]) do
        # Admin searches use literal mode for performance on indexed columns
        {query, qparams} = QueryHelper.build_select(
          "users",
          [{field, value}],
          literal_match: true
        )
        repo.query(query, qparams)
      end
    end

    defp validate_search_field(nil), do: {:error, :missing_field}
    defp validate_search_field(field) when field in ~w(email username display_name department), do: {:ok, field}
    defp validate_search_field(_), do: {:error, :invalid_field}

    defp validate_search_value(nil), do: {:error, :missing_value}
    defp validate_search_value(value) when is_binary(value) and byte_size(value) > 0 and byte_size(value) <= 200, do: {:ok, value}
    defp validate_search_value(_), do: {:error, :invalid_value}

    defp validate_identifier(%{"email" => email}) when is_binary(email) and byte_size(email) > 0, do: {:ok, {:email, email}}
    defp validate_identifier(%{"username" => uname}) when is_binary(uname) and byte_size(uname) > 0, do: {:ok, {:username, uname}}
    defp validate_identifier(_), do: {:error, :invalid_identifier}

    defp validate_password(%{"password" => pw}) when is_binary(pw) and byte_size(pw) >= 8, do: {:ok, pw}
    defp validate_password(_), do: {:error, :invalid_password}

    defp lookup_user({:email, email}, repo), do: UserLookup.find_by_email(email, repo)
    defp lookup_user({:username, uname}, repo), do: UserLookup.find_by_username(uname, repo)

    defp verify_credentials(%{password_hash: hash}, password) do
      if PasswordHasher.verify(password, hash), do: :ok, else: {:error, :invalid_credentials}
    end

    defp verify_admin(%{role: "admin"}), do: :ok
    defp verify_admin(_), do: {:error, :unauthorized}

    defp create_session(user) do
      session_id = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32) |> Base.url_encode64()
      SessionStore.put(session_id, %{user_id: user.id, role: user.role})
      {:ok, %{session_id: session_id, user_id: user.id}}
    end
  end
end
